clearedSpotChecks.note: Tempo main's Cargo.lock pins evm2 7c9f3b6deb23005fc84596ba1b13a6492d942014 and the a9d6748 lock pins 35aa32800b147b00e616d4e1869a3835aa86701f; the endpoint answers tempo/v1.19.1-a9d6748 and tempo v1.19.2 Cargo.lock returns 404. I fetched crates/evm2/src/interpreter/instructions/{arithmetic,bitwise,control,i256,memory,crypto,host,system,stack}.rs, bytecode/analysis.rs, bytecode/analysis/x86.rs and bytecode/analysis/aarch64.rs at both commits from raw.githubusercontent.com and the sha256 of each pair is equal. The memory limit arithmetic holds: 3,276,800 words cost 3*w + w^2/512, about 2.1e10 gas. The work directory's dl/evm2-7c9f3b6 folder is empty; the comparison it relies on is in evm2_7c9f/ and my own fetch confirms it.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Does the reth commit tempo main pins for the next release (5537d69) commit speculative prewarm results without re-running a transaction?
clearedSpotChecks.note: Tempo main pins reth-engine-tree 2.11.0 at 5537d6927c14d0be2d3b1505fd305097014233d0. In that commit crates/engine/tree/src/tree/payload_processor/mod.rs lines 456-461 build PrewarmResults only when reuse_prewarm_results, Transactions mode, no decoded block access list, cfg_reuses_prewarm_results and evm_config.reuses_prewarm_results() all hold; crates/engine/primitives/src/config.rs lines 289 and 380 default prewarm_reuse to false; crates/evm/evm/src/lib.rs line 684 defaults reuses_prewarm_results to false, and tempo main's crates/evm/src/lib.rs contains no prewarm override. Turning reuse on would need a node operator's flag, which is actor operator, not an ordinary account. settle (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364) reads balanceOfSelf on executed state.

clearedSpotChecks.check: TIP-1060 Refund mode charges 245,000 gas upfront for every zero to nonzero write in a transaction, including slots cleared earlier in the same transaction, and refunds only after the top-level frame. Can an ordinary account use this to make other users' PoolManager calls fail?
clearedSpotChecks.note: tips/tip-1060.md on tempo main confirms STORAGE_CREDIT_VALUE 245,000 charged upfront in Refund mode on every present 0 to new nonzero write, settlement after the top-level frame, credits per account and non-transferable, mode chosen only by the account itself through the precompile at 0x1060000000000000000000000000000000000000, and the EIP-3529 refund cap removed. The only external calls in src/ are Hooks.sol:134 (IHooks selectors), Currency.sol:48 (empty calldata) and Currency.sol:73 (transfer selector 0xa9059cbb), all with gas() and all reverting the whole call on failure, so the PoolManager can never call setMode or setBudget and no sub-call failure is swallowed into a different result. Credits minted when other users clear PoolManager slots end up refunding gas to whichever transaction later creates PoolManager slots; this moves gas fees, not PoolManager balances, and is not a loss or freeze path. Related correction to cleared item 2 of this file: Tempo's eth_call gas cap is 50,000,000, not 25,000,000. eth_call on rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz to code 0x5a60005260206000f3 with gas 0x3b9aca00 returned GAS = 0x2f6cde6, the same as with gas 0x2faf080, while 0x1c9c380 returned 0x1c5a0e6. Cycle 25 also recorded 50,000,000. This does not change that item's matching words.
